purpose: Copy an array or object, or apply a mutating operation to a copy. Use when updating signal values while preserving the original data.
Add, remove, replace, filter, sort, or flatten array items without mutating the input. Use these operations inside signal setters or data transformations.
Select, omit, split, or merge object properties. Read a nested path or replace its value without mutating the original object or array.
Apply arithmetic operations or clamp a value to a range. Use as small functions when composing calculations and value updates.
Convert incoming strings into JSON, NDJSON records, lines, or numbers. Compose parsers and provide a fallback on errors, for example in SSE or WebSocket message transforms.
Wrap signal/store setters to run logic on writes, such as persistence. Create interactive state that uses a reactive signal in the browser and a plain mutable value during server rendering.
Parse and convert color formats, adjust or mix colors, check text/background contrast, and build color scales. Channel metadata and translated color names support color pickers and accessible labels.
